| The Game Award for Game of the Year | |-| | [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/e3/The_Game_Awards_2023_-_Game_of_the_Year_acceptance_speech_%28cropped%29.png/250px-The_Game_Awards_2023_-_Game_of_the_Year_acceptance_speech_%28cropped%29.png)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:The_Game_Awards_2023_-_Game_of_the_Year_acceptance_speech_(cropped).png)
[Larian Studios](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Larian_Studios) won Game of the Year for _[Baldur's Gate 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Baldur's_Gate_3)_ in [2023](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2023). | | Awarded for | Best [video game](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Video_game) of the year | | Most recent winner | _[Clair Obscur: Expedition 33](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clair_Obscur:_Expedition_33)_ ( [2025](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2025)) | The most recent winner is _[Clair Obscur: Expedition 33](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clair_Obscur:_Expedition_33)_ by Sandfall Interactive. ## Process and history [[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Award_for_Game_of_the_Year#cite_note-2020_Polygon-4) As a result, any game released after the cutoff date is eligible in the following year's ceremony,[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Award_for_Game_of_the_Year#cite_note-FAQ-1) such as 2018's _[Super Smash Bros. Ultimate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Super_Smash_Bros._Ultimate)_ nominations at [the Game Awards 2019](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2019);[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Award_for_Game_of_the_Year#cite_note-2019_TheGamer-5) similarly, games released between the ballot due date in early November and the cutoff date in mid-to-late November are often overlooked, such as _[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars_Jedi:_Fallen_Order)_ in both 2019 and [2020](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2020)[[a]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Award_for_Game_of_the_Year#cite_note-9) and _[Demon's Souls](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demon's_Souls_(2020_video_game))_ and _[Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marvel's_Spider-Man:_Miles_Morales)_ in 2020.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Award_for_Game_of_the_Year#cite_note-2020_Polygon-4) [Early access](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Early_access) games available before the cutoff date are eligible, as are [live service](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Live_service) games regardless of their release year:[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Award_for_Game_of_the_Year#cite_note-FAQ-1) 2018's _[Among Us](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Among_Us)_ received several nominations in 2020. [[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Award_for_Game_of_the_Year#cite_note-2014_Daily_Dot-12)[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Award_for_Game_of_the_Year#cite_note-2015_DarkZero-19)[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Award_for_Game_of_the_Year#cite_note-2016_Twitter-20)[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Award_for_Game_of_the_Year#cite_note-2017_Polygon-21) Other presenters include directors of past winners—such as [2016](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2016) winner _[Overwatch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Overwatch_(2016_video_game))_'s lead director [Jeff Kaplan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jeff_Kaplan) in 2018,[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Award_for_Game_of_the_Year#cite_note-2018_USgamer-22) 2020 winner _[The [2021](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2021),[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Award_for_Game_of_the_Year#cite_note-2021_Push_Square-13) 2021 winner _[It Takes Two](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/It_Takes_Two_(video_game))_'s director [Josef Fares](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Josef_Fares) in [2022](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2022),[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Award_for_Game_of_the_Year#cite_note-2022_VentureBeat-23) 2023 winner _[Baldur's Gate web.title: All The Game Awards Game Of The Year Winners To Date
web.description:
At The Game Awards last week, [Clair Obscur: Expedition 33](https://www.gamespot.com/games/clair-obscur-expedition-33/) became the 12th title to win Game of the Year.

Surprisingly, Nintendo has only won the award once, for [The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild](https://www.gamespot.com/games/the-legend-of-zelda-breath-of-the-wild/) in 2017. Microsoft has yet to win any, although it now owns Activision, which took home the award in 2019 for [Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice](https://www.gamespot.com/games/sekiro-shadows-die-twice/).

CD Projekt’s 2015 win for [The Witcher 3: The Wild Hunt](https://www.gamespot.com/games/the-witcher-3-wild-hunt/) cemented its status as one of the top independent publishers in the industry.

## Game of the Year 2017 — The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
- Horizon Zero Dawn
- Persona 5
- Super Mario Odyssey

## Game of the Year 2018 — God of War
- Assassin’s Creed Odyssey
- Celeste
- Marvel’s Spider-Man
- Monster Hunter: World
- Red Dead Redemption 2

## Game of the Year 2021 — It Takes Two
- Deathloop
- Metroid Dread
- Psychonauts 2
- Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart
- Resident Evil Village

## Game of the Year 2022 — Elden Ring
- God of War Ragnarök
- Horizon Forbidden West
- Stray
- Xenoblade Chronicles 3
